card.name: Be aware of / familiar with phrases
card.fires_on: Small words right after clinician-awareness wording such as "Be aware" or "familiar", and a few similar spots in warnings about interactions and emergencies. The marked word is usually "of" or "with".

modes.label: Awareness phrases
modes.description: The linking word after "Be aware" or "be familiar" that introduces what the reader should know.
modes.example: Intervention: Be aware<< of>> this potential interaction. No treatment or other

modes.label: Emergency wording
modes.description: The word "emergencies" or its ending in anesthetic emergency management text.
modes.example: during therapeutic use of local anesthetics. (See ADVERSE REACTIONS, WARNINGS and PRECAUTIONS ). Management of local anesthetic<< emergencies>>: The first consideration is prevention, best
